answer: Agents bond stake to an epoch-scoped polynomial identity commitment, then use Semaphore membership proofs and RLN evaluations to authorize messages without exposing identity. Reusing a rate-limit slot produces distinct Shamir shares of the same secret; anyone can interpolate the private key, verify the evidence, and trigger immediate collateral slashing. The haven, willow, and canyon labels can identify separate epochs or domains, keeping proofs and penalties scoped to the right context.
